difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a finite ring map is of finite type, and that finite presentation as a module implies finite presentation as an algebra (statement lines 888-896). The proof does not invoke general presentation theory: it observes that module generators are algebra generators and then writes an explicit polynomial presentation from the module relations, the expression of the unit and the structure constants (proof lines 898-912). Producing that explicit presentation is what settles the second assertion. H2.
